ItemID: NA; Title: Hypnotic Eye; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: My recent interest in You Should Be So Lucky makes more music connected to Tom Petty especially appealing; this is my first pick.
ItemID: NA; Title: Different Shades Of Blue; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Blues guitar fits my recent Hendrix and Clapton listening, so I would try this too.
ItemID: NA; Title: Revelator; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The soulful blues sound fits my interests, but I would save it for another visit.
ItemID: NA; Title: Wrecking Ball; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am looking for blues and guitar-focused rock right now, and this title alone does not give me a clear reason to choose it.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Endless River; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Atmospheric instrumental rock is less appealing than the blues songs I want at the moment.
ItemID: NA; Title: Blak and Blu; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The blues-rock direction appeals to my Hendrix interest, but I would leave it for later.
ItemID: NA; Title: NY Greatest Hits; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I cannot tell whose compilation this is, so I would skip it rather than guess.
ItemID: NA; Title: Wings Over America; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Familiar classic rock sounds appealing, but a long live album is not my priority this visit.
ItemID: NA; Title: In Session; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: A blues session could suit my Clapton listening, but I would want to confirm the performers before choosing it.
ItemID: NA; Title: Plain Spoken; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Roots-oriented songwriting fits my recent listening, but I am more interested in the two blues-rock picks today.
